m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, handoff, g1 result. Verify handoff is complete.
m0-context.result: Handoff complete: task=g2 ablation retrain, intent=test hypothesis (a), scope=qual_power_adapter probe edit + scratch retrains + harness, exclusions=no gold cycle/fusion/Piece-2, evidence=g2_numbers.json, stop conditions=retrain errors / contract cascade beyond 2 attempts.

m1-setup-dirs.title: Create condition-specific records dirs
m1-setup-dirs.imperative: mkdir .agent-work/451/records_g2_control and .agent-work/451/records_g2_pace. Copy rh_2024 and rh_2025 records from .agent-work/451/records/ into both dirs (shared rh for apples-to-apples). mkdir .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_control and .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_pace for artifact-root.

postconditions.statement: dirs exist and rh records copied

m2-control-splitA.title: CONTROL retrain split A (eval 2024)
m2-control-splitA.imperative: Retrain driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend with --train-years 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 --eval-year 2024 --seed 0 --artifact-root .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_control --run-name control_splitA. Then emit rw_2024.record.json into records_g2_control using backtest-latent-power-module --emit-module-record.
constraints: no src edit yet; use current code as-is; --seed 0

m3-control-splitB.title: CONTROL retrain split B (eval 2025 OOS)
m3-control-splitB.imperative: Retrain driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend with --train-years 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 --eval-year 2025 --seed 0 --artifact-root .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_control --run-name control_splitB. Then emit rw_2025.record.json into records_g2_control.

m4-probe-edit.title: PROBE edit to quali_power_adapter.py
m4-probe-edit.imperative: Edit src/evo_predictor/quali_power_adapter.py: (1) append 'cross_channel_min_pace' to DRIVER_QUALI_POWER_FEATURE_NAMES tuple; (2) in _driver_vector() after the qs_sector_available block, compute pace_val = NaN-safe min(driver.qs_best_raw, driver.lr_best_raw), fallback to 0.0 if either is NaN, append to values list. Mark # PROBE g2 #451 — revert. Bump feature_schema_version suffix to v3-probe.

postconditions.statement: DRIVER_QUALI_POWER_FEATURE_NAMES has 24 entries and adapter imports cleanly

check.command: cd C:/Programs/f1Brainz-worktrees/cmdr-451 && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 py -c "from src.evo_predictor.quali_power_adapter import DRIVER_QUALI_POWER_FEATURE_NAMES; print(len(DRIVER_QUALI_POWER_FEATURE_NAMES))" 2>&1

constraints: minimal reversible edit only; mark # PROBE g2 #451 — revert; do NOT bump to promoted path

m5-pace-splitA.title: +PACE retrain split A (eval 2024)
m5-pace-splitA.imperative: Retrain driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend with the probe edit active, --train-years 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 --eval-year 2024 --seed 0 --artifact-root .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_pace --run-name pace_splitA. Emit rw_2024.record.json into records_g2_pace.

preconditions.statement: probe edit applied and adapter loads with 24 features

m6-pace-splitB.title: +PACE retrain split B (eval 2025 OOS)
m6-pace-splitB.imperative: Retrain driver_quali_power_from_race_weekend with probe edit active, --train-years 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 --eval-year 2025 --seed 0 --artifact-root .agent-work/451/scratch_runs/g2_pace --run-name pace_splitB. Emit rw_2025.record.json into records_g2_pace.

m7-harness-control.title: Run harness on CONTROL records
m7-harness-control.imperative: Set QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR to records_g2_control, run scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py UNMODIFIED. Capture stdout. Extract rw acc, ceiling, pairs for 2024 and 2025 regimes.

preconditions.statement: rw and rh records for 2024 and 2025 in records_g2_control

postconditions.statement: harness runs and prints rw / ceiling / pairs

m8-harness-pace.title: Run harness on +PACE records
m8-harness-pace.imperative: Set QUALI_SAME_PAIRS_RECORDS_DIR to records_g2_pace, run scripts/diagnose_quali_same_pairs.py UNMODIFIED. Capture stdout. Extract rw acc, ceiling, pairs for 2024 and 2025.

preconditions.statement: rw and rh records for 2024 and 2025 in records_g2_pace

postconditions.statement: harness runs and prints rw / ceiling / pairs

m9-write-evidence.title: Write g2_numbers.json
m9-write-evidence.imperative: Write .agent-work/451/evidence/g2_numbers.json with keys as_is_control (per-split rw/ceiling/pairs), pace_feature (per-split rw/ceiling/pairs), splits (description), points_to ('a'|'not_a'|'ambiguous').

preconditions.statement: both harness runs completed with numbers captured

check.command: cd C:/Programs/f1Brainz-worktrees/cmdr-451 && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 py -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.agent-work/451/evidence/g2_numbers.json')); print('as_is_control' in d, 'pace_feature' in d, d.get('points_to'))" 2>&1

constraints: do not decide verdict — just report numbers + direction

m10-result.title: Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m10-result.imperative: Write g2-implementer-result.md to .agent-work/451/evidence/ with full IMPLEMENTER_RESULT format: per-split numbers, direction, adapter diff, files changed, src edit status, assumptions, stop conditions, out-of-scope, workflow feedback.
